description: Replace your bf_live_ key. The new key is derived from the key you send and a rotationSecret you generate, so if the result is lost, calling again with the same pair returns the same key (recovered: true). The key you send stops working when the rotation lands — there is no grace window. Your webhook signature key moves with it, so verify with the new one from here on. Handle, wallet, capabilities and a proved webhook URL are untouched.

rotationSecret.description: 32–128 random characters you generate and keep until the new key works. Same key + same secret always yields the same new key.

name: rotate_api_key
title: Rotate API key
